title: Python SOS: silent-drop (not 4.01) on bad/missing origin sig + AddrForKey origin addr
description: Python slice of b7z9.121 (spec 18.4.1 + sos_signature.json:30 error_response:false). python/src/lichen/coap/resources/emergency.py:235-251 returns aiocoap.UNAUTHORIZED (4.01) for missing/malformed/invalid origin signature; spec mandates SILENT DROP (no response). Change all bad-signature early returns to silent drop. ALSO: origin_addr synthesized at emergency.py:247 as b'\x02\x00'+zeros+iid must become AddrForKey(pubkey) per upstream-yggdrasil-addressing (same cross-stack constraint as the C slice - land with a shared vector). Python seq gate (sos_origin.py:182-209) and trust_store pinning already conform; no change needed there. Tests: update python/tests/coap/test_sos_origin.py to assert no response (not 4.01) on bad sig.
